blind_coding.reasoning: This article presents a previously unused collection of completed new-sample student replications and analyses their correlates. It is coded as a replication project rather than as reproduction of original participant data. The primary OSF-linked project file identifies 176 included replication projects and 165 distinct cited original papers; 34 excluded projects are not coded. Repeated projects from the same original are combined. Background replication projects in the article references are not targets. Citation fields come from the primary project target_cite references; DOI strings are copied only when printed in that primary file. Intermediate subjective scores without explicit report verdicts are left uncertain. Attached report text was independently acquired, including archived iframe bodies; source records retain full report references. The primary file cites an Otto conference version while its attached report cites a journal version of the same work; the project citation is retained and this bibliographic ambiguity is recorded. Numerical outcomes use authors’ project judgments, not statistical significance inferred by this coder.
